text:
Sterile normal saline (0.9% sodium chloride) is the standard bladder washout solution. Sterile water is never used because it is hypotonic and can cause hemolysis and fluid absorption, and antiseptic or antibiotic additives are added only on a prescriber's order. Keep the fluid at room temperature or near body temperature, since cold fluid can trigger bladder spasm, and follow your facility protocol and the prescriber's order for volume and technique.
